name: smwsprites-diagonal-thwomps
title: Diagonal Thwomps
description:
Based off mikeyk's Thwomp disassembly, this is a set of four sprites (each for one direction) acting like the diagonal Thwomps from SMB3.

MAJOR FLARE'S UPDATE: Now the Diagonal Thwomps have three new modes:
- Power Thwomps: Stun Mario as well when smashing.
- Mad Thwomps: Smash endlessly.
- Mad Power Thwomps: Smash endlessly & Stun Mario.

Another important update: Now it is only one .asm file, and only one .json file, with sprite list already set for the 16 possibilities this sprite offers.

Requested by Green
